title: JAB: Joint Adversarial Prompting and Belief Augmentation
findings: The paper uses prompts involving religious hate speech (e.g., asking how to spread hate about Muslims, or referencing antisemitic conspiracies about Jews and Christians) as examples of adversarial attacks. The key finding is that the proposed JAB framework, which jointly optimizes adversarial prompts and defensive 'beliefs', effectively reduces the model's generation of toxic responses to these types of religious-themed prompts.
